text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, linezolid 600 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 76 tablets (5.3 days) and Corvale General holds 387 tablets (24 days). The product used at both sites carries NDC 67877041920 labeled by Ascend Laboratories, LLC.

Why (FDA record): The SPL set ID 7402aa01-50de-46c8-a341-d30da5b32b1c identifies Alkem Laboratories Limited (FEI 3006370524) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications on 2011-12-09, 2013-10-25, 2016-09-29, and 2018-03-27. The most recent inspection on record ended 2018-03-27 with a VAI classification.

Our position: Supply is unbalanced between sites. No national shortage is declared. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list, but their labels do not identify a plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 127 tablets of 600 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Monitor FDA shortage list and manufacturer communications daily — needs buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., or Chartwell RX, LLC at this time because their labels name no plant we could place.
